title: Hearty Dutch Vegetable Hash
description: A lacto-vegetarian friendly dish featuring caramelized vegetables and chimichurri sauce, perfect for a sick day
instructions: Caramelize the sliced onions in a large skillet over medium heat for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally
Add the grated carrots, halved brussels sprouts, and diced parsnips to the skillet and cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally
Stir in the chimichurri sauce, vegetable oil, salt, and black pepper, and cook for an additional 2 minutes
Transfer the vegetable mixture to a serving dish and top with crumbly feta cheese
Serve the hearty Dutch vegetable hash hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired
Let the dish rest for 5 minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld together
Reheat the dish in the microwave or oven if it cools down too quickly
